name: Aglianico del Vulture

known.via: English Wikipedia "Aglianico del Vulture" (a wine place on Wikidata)

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata. The label names a precise area, and the wine is tested during production.

notes: Aglianico del Vulture can be full bodied and richly textured, with firm tannin and chocolate-cherry notes.
Young wines can be rustic and harsh, but they soften and grow silky with age.
They can improve in bottle for 6 to 20 years.

blurb.text: A red wine from the Aglianico grape, grown on volcanic soils from Mount Vulture in Basilicata.
